info.name: Ninja Van API (ninjaAPI) OAuth API Order API API

items.docs: Creates a delivery order. Version 4.2 of the create-order endpoint. The request describes the service, the pickup (from) and delivery (to) parties, and the parcel job (dimensions, delivery instructions, cash on delivery, delivery timeframe).
Creates a delivery order using version 4.1 of the create-order endpoint. Retained alongside 4.2 for existing integrations.

params.name: trackingNo
params.description: The tracking number of the order to cancel.

items.docs: Cancels an order that has not yet been picked up, by its tracking number.

params.name: tid
params.description: One or more tracking numbers to include on the waybill.

params.name: hide_shipper_details
params.description: Whether to hide the shipper's details on the waybill.

items.docs: Generates a waybill (air waybill / shipping label) PDF for one or more tracking numbers. Access to this endpoint must be granted by Ninja Van before use.
